key_insight: A physics-driven CCD noise synthesis pipeline can recreate realistic, scientifically interpretable noise in astronomical images, enabling reliable paired training data for learning-based denoisers without relying on scarce real clean/noisy pairs.
problem_solved: Addresses the shortage of paired clean/noisy astronomical training data and the need for physically interpretable, reproducible noise models in CCD-based imaging pipelines—limits that hinder deployment and trust of ML denoisers in scientific workflows.
method: Construct a modular, physics-based noise model of CCD image formation that explicitly simulates dominant noise sources (photon shot noise, detector electronics/read noise, bias/offsets and other instrument effects).
Generate realistic noisy images from high-fidelity clean inputs to produce paired training data for supervised denoising, while preserving physical interpretability and reproducibility.
Integrate with standard calibration pipelines and validate synthetic noise characteristics against real observed frames to ensure statistical and scientific fidelity.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a reproducible way to produce realistic training data and to train denoisers that respect astrophysical signal fidelity, reducing risk of artifact introduction and improving scientific usability of ML-based denoising.
visual_elements: Pipeline flowchart showing clean image → physics-based noise modules (photon, read, bias, electronics) → synthetic noisy image → supervised denoiser
Stacked bar or radar chart breaking down contribution of different noise sources (photon vs read vs bias) to total variance
Before/after image pair of a deep-sky target with zoomed-in residuals and astrophysical metric annotations (e.g., source flux preservation)
Validation plot comparing statistics (e.g., noise histograms, power spectra, or residual distributions) of synthetic vs real CCD frames
paper_title: Denoising the Deep Sky: Physics-Based CCD Noise Formation for Astronomical Imaging
paper_authors: Shuhong Liu, Xining Ge, Ziying Gu, Lin Gu, Ziteng Cui
